Class 11 Chemistry · The s-Block Elements (flame test)
Chemistry, visualised #6

Lithium: crimson red. Sodium: yellow. Potassium: violet. Calcium: brick red. Barium: apple green → B.
Why: the flame's heat kicks an electron up to a higher shell. It falls back and gives out the energy as light of one exact colour: E = hc/λ. Barium's drop is 2.37 eV = 524 nm, green.
Every metal has its own drops, so its own colour. That's how fireworks get their colours.
